data.name: مُحَمَّدٌ
data.desc: The most praised and commendable. The primary name mentioned in the Quran.

data.name: أَحْمَدٌ
data.desc: The name by which Prophet Isa (AS) foretold his arrival (Quran 61:6).

data.name: حَامِدٌ
data.desc: One who constantly praises Allah.

data.name: مَحْمُودٌ
data.desc: One who is commended and praised for his noble qualities.

data.name: قَاسِمٌ
data.desc: The one who distributes the bounties and knowledge of Allah.

data.name: عَاقِبٌ
data.desc: The final Prophet after whom there is no other messenger.

data.name: فَاتِحٌ
data.desc: The one through whom the gates of guidance and mercy were opened.

data.name: خَاتِمٌ
data.desc: Khatam-an-Nabiyyin — the Seal of the Prophets (Quran 33:40).

data.name: حَاشِرٌ
data.desc: The one at whose feet people will be gathered on the Day of Resurrection.

data.name: مَاحِي
data.desc: The one through whom Allah erases disbelief (Kufr).

data.name: طَـهَ
data.desc: A title from the Quran; often interpreted as 'O Man'.

data.name: يـس
data.desc: A title from the Quran; addressing the Chief of the Messengers.

data.name: مُزَّمِّلٌ
data.desc: Addressing his state during early revelations (Quran 73:1).

data.name: مُدَّثِّرٌ
data.desc: Addressing his state when the command to preach was given (Quran 74:1).

data.name: شَاهِدٌ
data.desc: Witness over his Ummah on the Day of Judgment (Quran 33:45).

data.name: مُبَشِّرٌ
data.desc: Bringer of news of Paradise for believers.

data.name: نَذِيرٌ
data.desc: Warner against the consequences of disbelief.

data.name: بَشِيرٌ
data.desc: Bringer of good news to humanity.

data.name: مُنِيرٌ
data.desc: A luminous lamp of guidance (Siraj-an-Munira).

data.name: دَاعٍ
data.desc: The one who invites humanity to the path of Allah.

data.name: سِرَاجٌ
data.desc: Providing light and clarity in darkness.

data.name: مِصْبَاحٌ
data.desc: Reflecting the divine light of the Quran.

data.name: رَحْمَةٌ
data.desc: Rahmatal-lil-Alamin — Mercy to all worlds (Quran 21:107).

data.name: نِعْمَةٌ
data.desc: The greatest blessing bestowed upon mankind.

data.name: هَادٍ
data.desc: Directing hearts to the Straight Path.

data.name: شَفِيعٌ
data.desc: The one who will intercede for his Ummah of Judgment.

data.name: رَؤُوفٌ
data.desc: Deep compassion for the believers (Quran 9:128).

data.name: رَحِيمٌ
data.desc: Possessing extreme mercy towards the faithful.

data.name: أَمِينٌ
data.desc: Al-Amin — known for integrity even before Prophethood.

data.name: صَادِقٌ
data.desc: As-Sadiq — one who never uttered a lie.

data.name: مُبِينٌ
data.desc: Clear evidence of Prophethood.

data.name: شَكُورٌ
data.desc: The most grateful of servants to Allah.

data.name: عَزِيزٌ
data.desc: Dear to him is the suffering of the believers (Quran 9:128).

data.name: حَرِيصٌ
data.desc: Deeply concerned for the guidance of people.

data.name: طَـيِّبٌ
data.desc: Pure in character and essence.

data.name: مُبَارَكٌ
data.desc: Full of Barakah in teachings and heart.

data.name: عَالِمٌ
data.desc: Gifted with the highest divine knowledge.

data.name: حَكِيمٌ
data.desc: Representing Hikmah (Wisdom) alongside the Quran.

data.name: طَاهِرٌ
data.desc: Free from all impurities.

data.name: مُطَهَّرٌ
data.desc: Directly purified by Allah.

data.name: مَنْصُورٌ
data.desc: Aided with clear victory.

data.name: مُقْتَصِدٌ
data.desc: Model of the moderate path.

data.name: عَبْدُ اللَّهِ
data.desc: His most honored title (Quran 17:1).

data.name: عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَٰنِ
data.desc: Perfect servitude to Ar-Rahman.

data.name: حَبِيبُ اللَّهِ
data.desc: Most beloved of all creation.

data.name: صَفِيُّ اللَّهِ
data.desc: Chosen from among all men.

data.name: نَجِيُّ اللَّهِ
data.desc: In close spiritual proximity to the Divine.

data.name: تَقِيُّ
data.desc: Pinnacle of Taqwa.

data.name: زَكِيُّ
data.desc: Virtuous and clean and growing in goodness.

data.name: وَلِيُّ
data.desc: Close ally of Allah and His believers.

data.name: مُقْتَفِِي
data.desc: Follower of previous prophets and their messages.

data.name: مُقَفَّى
data.desc: Sent at the end of the line of prophets.

data.name: رَسُولُ الْمَلَاحِمِ
data.desc: Messenger during the times of great trials/battles.

data.name: رَسُولُ الرَّحْمَةِ
data.desc: Sent as a mercy for the whole world.

data.name: مُذْكِرٌ
data.desc: One who reminds humanity of their Lord.

data.name: مَأْمُونٌ
data.desc: Trusted with the revelation and trust of men.

data.name: مَعْلُومٌ
data.desc: Well-known in the heavens and the earth.

data.name: شَهِيـرٌ
data.desc: Renowned across all generations.

data.name: مُصَدِّقٌ
data.desc: Confirming the truth of previous scriptures.

data.name: مُنِيـرٌ
data.desc: Shining with the light of guidance.

data.name: نَاصِرٌ
data.desc: Helper of the truth and the oppressed.

data.name: مَنْصُورٌ
data.desc: Aided by Allah with angels and victory.

data.name: مِصْبَاحٌ
data.desc: Guiding lamp in the darkness of ignorance.

data.name: سِرَاجٌ
data.desc: A luminous lantern for humanity.

data.name: هُدًى
data.desc: Source of spiritual and moral guidance.

data.name: مَهْدِيٌّ
data.desc: Perfectly guided by Allah's inspiration.

data.name: مُنِيبٌ
data.desc: Constantly turning to Allah in repentance and love.

data.name: مُرْتَضًى
data.desc: One with whom Allah is well-pleased.

data.name: مُجْتَبًى
data.desc: Chosen specifically for the final message.

data.name: مُصْطَفًى
data.desc: Purified and selected above all creation.

data.name: نَجِيـبٌ
data.desc: Of noble lineage and noble character.

data.name: مُعْتَمَدٌ
data.desc: The one whom the believers rely on for guidance.

data.name: مُوَفَّقٌ
data.desc: Aided with success in all his missions.

data.name: مُتَوَكِّلٌ
data.desc: The one who places ultimate trust in Allah.

data.name: كَرِيـمٌ
data.desc: Overflowing with spiritual and material generosity.

data.name: رَحِيـمٌ
data.desc: Kind and soft-hearted towards the believers.

data.name: مُشَفَّعٌ
data.desc: The one whose intercession is granted.

data.name: مُجَلٌّ
data.desc: Exalted and honored by Allah.

data.name: مُفَضَّلٌ
data.desc: Given preference over all other prophets.

data.name: مُنْتَصِرٌ
data.desc: Succeeding against the enemies of faith.

data.name: مُعْطٍ
data.desc: Distributor of the gifts of revelation.

data.name: جَوَادٌ
data.desc: Boundlessly giving with a noble heart.

data.name: صَبُورٌ
data.desc: Unshakable patience during trials.

data.name: حَلِيـمٌ
data.desc: Calm and slow to anger.

data.name: وَفِيٌّ
data.desc: Completely fulfilling the covenant with Allah.

data.name: أَمِيـرٌ
data.desc: Leader of the believers in heart and state.

data.name: جَامِعٌ
data.desc: Gathering people under the word of Tawheed.

data.name: مُجِيبٌ
data.desc: Answering the call of those in need.

data.name: قَوِيٌّ
data.desc: Incomparable spiritual and moral strength.

data.name: حَفِيـظٌ
data.desc: Preserving the message and the boundaries of Allah.

data.name: قَيَّامٌ
data.desc: Upholding the truth steadfastly.

data.name: شَافٍ
data.desc: Messenger through whom Allah heals hearts.

data.name: كَلِيمٌ
data.desc: Speaking with revelation and divine authority.

data.name: خَاتِمُ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ
data.desc: Closing the golden chain of Prophethood.

data.name: سَيِّدُ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
data.desc: The foremost among all the Messengers.

data.name: إِمَامُ الْمُتَّقِينَ
data.desc: The ultimate role model for the pious.

data.name: رَحْمَةٌ لِلْعَالَمِينَ
data.desc: A blessing for all existence (Quran 21:107).

data.name: صِدِّيقٌ
data.desc: Highest degree of truthfulness in speech and action.

data.name: مُحَمَّدٌ نَبِيُّ اللهِ
data.desc: The finalized Prophet of God. Muhammad ﷺ.
